observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon DSLR body with the word “Canon” and “800D” visible on the front-right area; a lens is mounted.
Photo 1 shows the back of the camera with the rear controls and a purple/blue reflection on the viewfinder area; a lens is still mounted.
Photo 2 shows the side/front angle with “Canon” and “EOS 800D” visible; lens front element is visible.

claims.claim: Neat UK used Canon 800D with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: The photos confirm Canon EOS 800D (photo 0 and photo 2), but the lens focal length “18-55mm” is not clearly readable in the provided images.

risks.risk: Lens model/focal length may not be 18-55mm (could be a different lens or a non-matching kit lens).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the lens barrel text showing the exact lens model (e.g., “18-55mm” and the lens name/series).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a Canon EOS 800D body with an unspecified/possibly non-18-55 kit lens (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Camera may have shutter count issues, sensor dust, or faults not visible in photos (e.g., autofocus problems, screen/viewfinder issues).
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a nearby object, and a test photo at 1x and zoomed-in view; plus a photo of the shutter count screen (if accessible).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with unknown condition (worst case: not guaranteed fully functional).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card) that affect real usability and resale value.
risks.proof: A single photo laid out showing every included item (battery, charger, lens caps, strap, USB/AV cable if any, memory card if any).
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming minimal/uncertain bundle (worst case: only what’s shown/typical without extras).

risks.risk: Potential scam/listing mismatch (photos could be of a different unit; condition claims can’t be verified remotely).
risks.proof: A photo of the camera with a handwritten note showing today’s date and the seller’s name/WhatsApp number, plus the same unit’s serial number label (if visible).
risks.if_unproven: Priced conservatively due to unverifiable listing authenticity.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the lens barrel showing the exact lens model and “18-55mm” text (or confirm the exact lens).
Photo of the camera’s serial number/label (and battery compartment) for unit verification.
Video test: power on, autofocus lock on, take a photo, and show the result on the screen.
List and photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card).
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Canon EOS 800D body, but the key pricing driver—the exact 18-55mm lens model and full working condition—cannot be confirmed from these images alone.
